correctness.rationale: The \(2\times2\) and \(3\times3\) strict domains are exhausted. For every profile all perfect matchings are checked by two independent blocking-pair implementations, which agree exactly. Regret and sex-equality costs use exact integer ranks. The stable-count marginal \(34080,11484,1092\), the disjoint objective pattern, both symmetry orbits, and the explicit witness all replay successfully.

value.rationale: Minimum regret protects the worst-off participant, while sex-equality balances aggregate dissatisfaction across the two sides. The first market size where these standard fairness principles can force mutually exclusive stable choices is a natural structural boundary. The exact \(1/324\) conflict incidence and two-orbit classification make the result more informative than a routine isolated witness.
